senses.gloss: m. (v. אוּדְנָא II) a cylindrical vessel, jar (dolium).
units: <cite ref="Yoma 28b:16">Yoma 28ᵇ</cite> <he>ד׳ דחלא</he> a jar of vinegar (which emits a stronger smell through a slight opening than when open).
